questions.text: A function f(x) is linear and has a value of 29 at x= -2 and 39 at x=3. Find its value at x=5.
questions.solution:
Slope = [latex]\frac{39-29}{3-(-2)}=2[/latex]

f(5) = 39 + 2 [latex]\times[/latex] (5 [latex]-[/latex] 3) = 43

Answer: 43

questions.text:
Select the pair of best expresses a relationship similar to that expressed in the pair:

Children : Pediatrician
questions.solution:
A paediatrician treats a group of people (children). Similarly, a gynaecologist treats a group of people (females). The others match an organ with its specialist.

Answer: Females : Gynaecologist

questions.text: Extreme focus on syllabus and studying for tests has become such a dominant concern of Indian student that they close their minds to anything ___________ to the requirements of the exam.
questions.solution:
Extraneous = irrelevant, unrelated. Students ignore anything not related to the exam.

Answer: extraneous

questions.text: The Tamil version of __________ John Abraham-starrer Madras Cafe __________ cleared by the Censor Board with no cuts last week, but the film's distributor _______ no takers among the exhibitors for a release in Tamilnadu _______ this Friday.
questions.solution:
"the John Abraham-starrer", "was cleared" (passive, singular), "distributor found" (past), release "on this Friday".

Answer: the, was, found, on

questions.text: If ROAD is written as URDG, then SWANshould be written as:
questions.solution:
Each letter moves 3 places forward: R[latex]\rightarrow[/latex]U, O[latex]\rightarrow[/latex]R, A[latex]\rightarrow[/latex]D, D[latex]\rightarrow[/latex]G.

S[latex]\rightarrow[/latex]V, W[latex]\rightarrow[/latex]Z, A[latex]\rightarrow[/latex]D, N[latex]\rightarrow[/latex]Q = VZDQ

Answer: VZDQ
